run_post_expert_eval: run the post_expert_eval script with a config name to evaluate expert models across downstream datasets
run_evaluate_logits: run evaluate_logits to compute zero-shot accuracy metrics for a given dataset using a CLIP model
run_slip_evaluate_expert: run slip_evaluate_expert to evaluate a model on all CLIP-Eval downstream tasks and save predictions
run_main: run main to load expert checkpoints and evaluate each model across all downstream datasets in distributed mode
review_evaluate_logits: review evaluate_logits to understand how different metrics like mean_per_class, accuracy, and roc_auc are selected per dataset
